scope: CPU engineering checks, not the frozen ISIC learned study

mirror_provenance.sampling: first four lexicographically listed JPGs; convenience sample, not representative or a study split
mirror_provenance.limitation: 224x224 mirror copies; official identity, native-original status, licence chain and patient independence unverified. No pixels redistributed.

mirror_comparison.scope: engineering trade-off comparison; not novelty, DICOM conformance or clinical validation
mirror_comparison.pairing: same source/operator/coordinates; method-specific reference and measured truth; masks are NOT assumed identical
mirror_comparison.key_policy: public deterministic benchmark keys; never production secrets
limitations: Signed digests authenticate decoded RGB, not image file metadata.
No PKI, revocation, freshness authority or blockchain integration.
Tile hashes and signatures are standard baselines, not new cryptography.
Sidecar bytes are this JSON encoding, not an optimised storage lower bound.
Key distribution, certificates and trusted version-registry overhead are excluded for all methods.
No learned localisation, clinical fidelity or population accuracy inferred.
Replay is possible if the receiver accepts an old image and old signed manifest at a reused version ID.
Timings are single local CPU executions, not statistically stable benchmarks.
